title: Unbiased pass@k Release Gate
hints: pass@k is the probability that at least one of k samples drawn without replacement from the n you generated passes: 1 - C(n-c, k) / C(n, k).
Average per problem (macro average). Pooling every sample into one n and c answers a different question.
C(n, k) overflows a float once n is in the low thousands. Rewrite the ratio as the product of (1 - k/i) for i from n-c+1 to n.
A problem with fewer than k samples cannot estimate pass@k. Report it as None, list it as skipped, and leave it out of the mean.
